_comment: Items Emile is selling. Claude writes this file from photos sent in chat; the page reads it. Status taps on the page are saved per-device in localStorage and override whatever is here, so the 'status' below is just the starting point.

items.title: Folk check flannel overshirt
items.listing_title: Folk Check Flannel Overshirt Green/Tan - Size 4 (L)
items.listing_description:
Folk brushed flannel overshirt in a green, tan and grey check, size 4 (Folk's own numbered sizing - roughly a UK L, check their size guide against your usual fit).

Condition: very good.

Measurements taken flat:
- Pit to pit: [measure before listing]
- Length from collar seam: [measure before listing]

From a smoke-free home. Sent tracked.
items.notes: You said Folk/Edwin pieces sat unsold even under £30 last time - that points to thin demand for these brands on Vinted rather than a pricing problem, so cutting further isn't guaranteed to fix it on its own. Priced at £22 to actually test whether price was ever the real lever. If this doesn't move within a couple of weeks either, the more useful fixes are probably: broader title keywords (buyers search 'flannel overshirt' more than 'Folk'), a couple more photos (worn/styled, not just on a hanger), or cross-posting to eBay for a different buyer pool - not going lower still.

items.title: Folk oatmeal chore jacket (polyester, not wool)
items.listing_title: Folk Chore Jacket Oatmeal - Textured Polyester - Men's M
items.listing_description:
Folk chore jacket in oatmeal, size M. Textured brushed polyester with a wool-look finish (not actual wool - checking the fabric label if that matters to you before buying). Buttoned front, chest patch pocket, two large lower patch pockets.

Condition: new without tags.

Measurements taken flat:
- Pit to pit: [measure before listing]
- Length from collar seam: [measure before listing]

From a smoke-free home. Sent tracked.
items.notes: IMPORTANT correction: you said this is actually polyester, not wool - you didn't realise at time of purchase. That's now stated plainly in the description, because fabric composition is printed on the garment's own care label and is exactly the kind of thing a buyer can check and dispute if the listing claims otherwise. Dropped the ask from £88 to £35 to match - a polyester chore jacket, even new without tags, doesn't hold the same resale value as genuine wool, whatever Folk's own RRP was for this piece. Worth a last check of the actual care label before listing, in case it's a wool blend rather than 100% polyester - that would nudge the price back up a bit.
